name: github PR-social production registration
$limitation: The review-fetch, composition, row parity, and alias-identity plans cover the handler and effects. This plan pins only the registry, independent route switches, production constructor, and Python admission boundary added when all three aliases become route-ready.

mutations.rationale: the checked-in matrix must not claim pr-comments is native unless the executor registry resolves it to the native Go path

mutations.find:
case provider == "github" && dataset == "pr-reviews":
		descriptor.Destinations = githubPRSocialRouteDestinations()
		descriptor.RouteReady = true
mutations.replace:
case provider == "github" && dataset == "pr-reviews":
		descriptor.Destinations = githubPRSocialRouteDestinations()
		descriptor.RouteReady = false
mutations.rationale: review enrichment closes the prior fabricated-zero gap, so the registry must advertise pr-reviews as route-ready
the production worker must construct the complete PR-social handler and composite sink for the pr-comments alias, not only advertise it in the matrix
the explicit environment switch must reach the Go descriptor rather than leaving a route-ready pair permanently disabled
Python dispatch admission must read the same default-off switch as the Go runtime so enabling pr-reviews actually routes that unit to River
two PR-social switches would schedule the same two-effect writer under distinct claim ledgers, so Go startup must reject every pairwise collision
Python admission must fail before dispatch when two alias switches would create duplicate provider work and ClickHouse effects
